title: On Advertising the winter sale
subtitle: 经济消费 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 经济消费（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·经济与消费）
meta: 主题语境：经济消费（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·经济与消费）　|　核心词汇：advertise　|　正文 326 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 advertise 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1949 the tailor ① advertised the winter sale at once, and every customer in the shop said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three weeks on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the tailor ② advertises the winter sale in the rain without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ advertise the winter sale at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ advertised the winter sale before — a line in the order for November 1943 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Advertising the winter sale at once, the tailor said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the needle at the far mirror, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ advertise the post in the paper in the rain, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Advertise the post in the paper at once and never mention it again.

By 1956 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the order, and a new customer from the next shop ⑧ advertises the post in the paper at once every week without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the mirror, said nothing at all; she simply  advertised the winter sale again when nobody else would.

To advertise the winter sale, my mother said in 1961, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the shop remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the shop forgets, somebody advertises the winter sale in the rain again and somebody must advertise the winter sale at once all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 为…做广告（一般过去式 advertised the winter sale：1949 年裁缝头一回这样做，二话不说地）
B. v. 为…做广告（一般现在 advertises the winter sale：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 为…做广告（不定式 to advertise the winter sale：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 为…做广告（过去完成时 had advertised the winter sale：1943 年十一月的订单簿上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 为…做广告（动名词 advertising the winter sale 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 公布（advertise the post in the paper：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去公布报上的那个职位）
G. v. 公布（advertise the post in the paper：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 为…做广告（后段两处：新来的顾客照例 advertises the post in the paper，而母亲又一次 advertised the winter sale）

items.q: advertise the post in the paper in the rain
advertise the post in the paper at once
advertises the post in the paper at once

answers.why: advertise 意为“为…做广告”，1949 年裁缝二话不说地为…做广告冬季那次大减价，那是裁缝铺里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 advertised。
advertise 意为“为…做广告”，自那以后裁缝淋着雨把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 advertises。
advertise 意为“为…做广告”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯为…做广告冬季那次大减价”，此处为不定式 to advertise the winter sale。
advertise 意为“为…做广告”，订单簿里 十一月 那行字说明早在 1956 年之前就有人为…做广告过，故用过去完成时 had advertised。
advertise 意为“为…做广告”，裁缝说“为…做广告冬季那次大减价这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 advertising the winter sale 作主语。
advertise 意为“公布”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去公布报上的那个职位”，should ever 之后用原形 advertise the post in the paper。
advertise 意为“公布”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻公布报上的那个职位（advertise the post in the paper at once），以后再也不要提起。
advertise 意为“为…做广告”，新来的顾客每个星期都照例公布报上的那个职位，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 advertises。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1949 年，裁缝二话不说地为…做广告冬季那次大减价；裁缝铺里每一个顾客都说这是头一回。（advertised the winter sale）
多年以后，裁缝仍淋着雨做着同一件事，不必有人开口。（advertises the winter sale）
母亲后来说，难就难在肯为…做广告冬季那次大减价这件事本身。（to advertise the winter sale）
早在 1943 年就有人为…做广告冬季那次大减价，十一月那天订单簿上的一行字就是证据。（had advertised the winter sale）
裁缝说过，二话不说地为…做广告冬季那次大减价这件事，是九分耐心一分胆气。（advertising the winter sale 作主语）
老手们留下的规矩说得明白：立刻公布报上的那个职位，以后再也不要提起。（advertise the post in the paper，祈使句）
answers: In 1949 the tailor advertised the winter sale at once, and every customer in the shop said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there.
Three weeks on, the tailor still advertises the winter sale in the rain without being asked.
My mother said later that to advertise the winter sale at all was the part nobody had expected.
Somebody had advertised the winter sale long before 1956, and the line in the order for November proves it.
Advertising the winter sale at once, the tailor said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
The rule the old hands handed down was plain: Advertise the post in the paper at once and never mention it again.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 advertise 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1949 the tailor advertised the winter sale at once, and nobody in the shop forgot it.
Even now the tailor advertises the winter sale in the rain whenever the shop asks.
Advertising the winter sale at once, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever advertise the post in the paper in the rain, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new customer from the next shop advertises the post in the paper at once every week, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother advertised the winter sale again, and the shop remembered that half.
